messages.content: On the app, please scan the living_room for smart devices, then check which of the discovered devices are offline and convert those results into a shareable format. After that, use that data to create a medium-priority note titled "Meeting Notes" for user_001 with the tags finance and travel, and then restart the Main Door Lock using device_id lock_main.
